name: Futano Sasa
source:
A second-year student. A member of the broadcasting club with a wicked tongue.

She's been stuck with Umi and Nena for a while now. When Umi's out of control it's Sasa's job to bring her back down to earth. Kind of a goth.

The type to want to pin her lover down.

Strength: Has more energy at night
Weaknesses: Mornings, not good with heat and sun
Hobbies: Dark fashion, watching movies
Skills: Reading aloud, imitating famous voices, abusive language

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/]English official website[/url]]
